title: Transient Amplification in Cascaded Gradient Methods: Exact Minimax Laws and Tracking without Resonance
abstract: arXiv:2606.04031v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Leader-follower gradient iterations, including bilevel and two-time-scale methods, can exhibit large finite-time excursions despite asymptotic stability. For cascaded iterations with block matrix J = [[A,0],[C,D]], symmetric diagonal blocks of norm at most gamma < 1, and coupling norm at most c, we prove an exact, dimension-free minimax formula: at every horizon t, the worst-case amplification equals the spectral norm of [[gamma^t,0],[c t gamma^(t-1),gamma^t]], attained by an aligned two-dimensional quadratic. Consequently, the worst transient is on the order of 1 + c/(1-gamma), and eigenvalues alone cannot predict finite-time gain. Under martingale noise, the aligned system has stationary follower variance sigma^2 c^2 (1+gamma^2)/(1-gamma^2)^3, establishing cubic inverse-gap scaling. For quadratic followers, the coupling is linked to follower sensitivity R by C = (I-D)R. When the leader is isotropic and the follower map is pos

translated_title: 级联梯度方法中的瞬态放大：精确极小极大定律与无共振跟踪
translated_abstract: 主从梯度迭代（包括双层优化和双时间尺度方法）尽管具有渐近稳定性，但仍可能出现较大的有限时间偏移。对于具有分块矩阵 J = [[A,0],[C,D]] 的级联迭代，其中对称对角块的范数至多为 γ < 1，耦合范数至多为 c，我们证明了一个精确的、与维度无关的极小极大公式：在任意时间范围 t，最坏情况的放大倍数等于矩阵 [[γ^t, 0], [c·t·γ^(t-1), γ^t]] 的谱范数，且该值可由一个对齐的二维二次问题达到。因此，最坏瞬态的量级为 1 + c/(1-γ)，且仅凭特征值无法预测有限时间增益。在鞅噪声下，对齐系统的平稳跟随者方差为 σ²c²(1+γ²)/(1-γ²)³，确立了三次逆间隙缩放规律。对于二次型跟随者，耦合与跟随者敏感度 R 通过 C = (I-D)R 相关联。当领导者为各向同性且跟随者映射为正……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文针对级联梯度方法首次给出精确且与维度无关的最坏瞬态放大极小极大公式，证明最坏瞬态为 1 + c/(1-γ) 量级、仅凭特征值无法预测有限时间增益，并在鞅噪声下确立了三次逆间隙缩放的跟踪方差定律。
